title.narrative: Integrated multi-sectoral response for conflict-affected community in North West zone of Tigray regional state, Ethiopia.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThis integrated multi-sector project proposal by WVE and MfM is dedicated to addressing the pressing needs of IDPs who are in Ziban Gedeba Secondary school and Shambel Sahle Elementary school in Tahtay Adiabo Woreda. The prioritized sectors in this project are ESNFI, CCCM, WASH, Education, and protection. ltbrgtIn the CCCM component, the project will focus on arranging logistic support for the relocation of the 474 HH in the mentioned school IDPs along with decommissioning and dismantling of self-made shelters in the schools. ltbrgtIn the emergency shelter part, the focus of the project will be on the provision of alternative shelters for relocated IDPs from schools. The project will use the cash for rent as an alternative to the relocated IDPs as per the cluster standards. ltbrgtWithin the education sector, the project aims to rehabilitate and equip 8 damaged classrooms, ensuring they are conducive to learning by providing essential teaching and learning materials and WASH facilities for 1989 students. It will also establish school-based child help desks, and referral systems, and promote a safe environment. The goal is to create inclusive and protective learning spaces, especially for crisis-affected children, including those with disabilities, and to strengthen the overall education service delivery systems. ltbrgtThe project targets addressing critical protection concerns among conflict-affected populations in the protection sector. This includes psychosocial distress among children, child abuse, neglect, child labor, child marriage, and exploitation. The focus is on providing integrated child protection prevention, and mine action prevention and response. Aiming to reach 12,904 individuals, with a priority on the most vulnerable, the project intends to ensure a safer environment for affected people. ltbrgtThe project in the WASH sector focuses on rehabilitating and constructing water supply systems and latrines in schools. This initiative also involves providing WASH NFIs to Internally Displaced Persons IDPs and promoting hygiene. Approximately 14,110 individuals are expected to benefit from this intervention. The WASH component aims to enhance access to safe drinking water and improved sanitation facilities. ltbrgtThe project underscores the importance of the Humanitarian-Development-Peace (HDP) nexus, integrating conflict-sensitive education, engaging local communities, establishing peace clubs, and fostering sectoral integration. This holistic approach aims to deliver effective and sustainable programs, aligning with the 2023 Ethiopia Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP) and ensuring a stronger and sustainable response to the crisis in the targeted areas.ltbrgtlt/pgt
